snippet.title: GHOSTED - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist GHOSTED: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4247840/GHOSTED/
Launches September 25, 2026 on Steam for PC and VR.

Dreambyte Games is publishing indie developer GeRoN's new 1-5 player co-op horror comedy game where YOU'RE the ghosts. Haunt the living, possess objects, and make your friends say ridiculous custom voice commands to trigger scares.

 #GHOSTED #coophorror  #indiegame  #horrorgaming
